display_long_description:
Your students are robots. Their patience is running out. Welcome to the wildest classroom in VR.

In **Robodies: Machine IS NOT Learning**, you're the teacher everyone needs at once. Read the room, answer demands, and keep the lesson alive before the bots turn it into a disaster.

**Fix the glitches.** Help a struggling student get back on track.

[media]

**Make it stick.** Draw on the board and teach with your own hands.

[media]

**Keep up.** Grab the right books as more hands shoot up.

[media]

**Handle the troublemakers.** Get up close when a bot stops listening.

[media]

**Beat the chaos.** Juggle requests, fights, and the clock before the whole class erupts.

[media]

No two lessons play the same. How long can you keep this class under control?
